title: `merge --ready` runs the records step and pushes it before it marks a PR ready, so a ready PR never carries a stale records page
why: Coordinator 05:47 CST Nov 15 (relayed; triage read no PR or log). Lane ready-refreshes-records (session_013NEJL2x8RHNnMo2B3gWMxy, sonnet, guard or check: yes) started on the consultant's order of 05:46 CST: consultant's pick under the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words, not an owner-typed pick. Fix: `merge --ready` runs the records step and pushes it before it marks a PR ready. Cost it stops (coordinator's relay): the merge tool refused ready PRs #3255 and #3472 tonight for a stale records page, each costing a full extra CI run. The lane also hunts any other refusal that only shows after the ready run. The lane is told to report whether any record names an owner of `merge.readyChecks` (triage's 04:30 CST read found none; see step ready-check-names-tree). Kin steps (all exist, checked 05:46 CST): records-page-before-ready (doing, older lane; the same class, and its ruling own-830-c-ci-scope-green-before-head kept the refusal at merge and the ready records push), records-stale-refuses-on-ready (done), ready-push-merges-main (doing), ready-pr-touched-tests, ready-check-names-tree. Not an alias of records-page-before-ready: that step's open fix is rebuilding before the ready run in general; this lane's fix is the `--ready` push alone. Overlap is the lane's first read. FINDING 05:49 CST Nov 15 (lane's report, relayed 05:48 CST; triage read none of the PRs or logs): the refusals on #3255 and #3472 came after runner 10 marked ready by MCP, not by `merge N --ready`, so the records step never ran; the tool did what decision records-index-at-merge says (lane's read of draft_step, merge/merge.py:4114; runner 10's refusal lines relayed by the coordinator). Triage's read of the decision on main (GitHub, 05:49 CST): it says 'the batch runner marks the PR ready by its session's route (route pr-ready-mcp-cloud), after the draft run of the pushed head shows' (the sentence runs from line 16 to 17 in the stable copy). Skill ci-hygiene line 69 says the ready route is `merge <pr> --ready`, which runs the records step. The two texts clash (confirmed by triage's read; the MCP-ready bypass itself is the lane's read). Lane options: (a) record-only: rewrite that decision sentence to say the runner readies with `merge N --ready` (lane's recommendation, not the owner's); (b) a guard refusing MCP update_pull_request draft=false on a PR with no --ready run (risk: false alarms in cloud where --ready's own mark may be refused by GraphQL); (c) confirm heals the page (restarts CI; against the decision). Lane builds nothing; says (a) to its parent. Undoable and record-only, so no owner item; coordinator/consultant decide. PICK 05:50 CST Nov 15 (coordinator's pick, undoable, relayed; not the owner's): option (a) is the picked route. The lane rewrites decision records-index-at-merge (the sentence on the runner marking ready by MCP route) in place so the runner readies with `merge N --ready`, and aligns skill ci-hygiene line 69. Not (b): no second incident yet and a cloud false-alarm risk; (b) is filed as later low step ready-mcp-mark-guard. The lane's PR is a draft and gets a fresh reviewer read, since a rule's text changes. Runner 10 was asked to try `merge N --ready` on #3255 and #3496 and report any refusal.
